concerns.text: The plan asserts a total wall‑clock limit of ≤6 hours (360 min) while also stating that each model/dataset combo takes ≤45 minutes. With 3 models × 3 datasets = 9 combos (each with three seeds), the cumulative runtime exceeds the 6‑hour budget (≈9 × 45 min = 405 min). This creates a feasibility conflict for the free‑tier GitHub Actions runner. Adjust the training schedule (e.g., reduce seeds, epochs, or dataset size) or provide evidence that the actual runtime fits within the 6‑hour limit.
